headline: Anthropic chief executive Dario Amodei was paid about $18 million for 2025, according to documents for the company's planned share sale.
score_reason: Pool score 7 lowered by 2: the Reuters report is from 6 Oct 2026, two days old, and the pay figure is of limited consequence by itself.
importance_line: What changed is that a first look at how Anthropic pays its leaders has surfaced, which matters mainly to prospective shareholders and to people comparing pay at AI companies, then to Anthropic and its partners, and the doubt is that these are 2025 figures from a prospectus and, as Equilar notes, the full picture will only come once his ownership stake is disclosed.
summary: Reuters reported on 6 Oct 2026, as relayed by Channel Insider, that an Anthropic IPO prospectus it obtained puts Dario Amodei's 2025 pay at $18 million, mostly stock and options, with his sister and company president Daniela Amodei at $16.4 million, and that both siblings' base salaries were doubled to $1.4 million in July. Courtney Yu of the pay-data firm Equilar told Reuters the figure "seems on the lower end for a company valued at $2 trillion"; it adds to our 5 Oct 2026 report on Anthropic's planned share sale (IPO).
notes: Reuters page blocked; text read in Channel Insider and Daily Sabah relays. Reuters url dated 6 Oct 2026, so the news is older than the pool date. Pool flagged it as a follow-up of the 5 Oct Anthropic IPO item.
